	type = character_event
	title = eir.0800.t
	desc = eir.0800.desc
	theme = war

	trigger = {
		has_variable = eir_rising_county
	}

	immediate = {
		var:eir_rising_county ?= {
			save_scope_as = eir_unrest_county
			change_county_control = major_county_control_loss
			add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_rebel_march_modifier years = 4 }
		}
		remove_variable = eir_rising_county
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0800.a
		stress_impact = {
			brave = minor_stress_impact_loss
			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes

			55 = {
				desc = eir.out.t800w
				modifier = {
					add = 15
					martial >= 12
				}

				scope:eir_unrest_county ?= { change_county_control = medium_county_control_gain }
				eir_trait_effect = { TRAIT = brave OPPOSITE = craven CHANCE = 25 }
			}
			45 = {
				desc = eir.out.t800l
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
				scope:eir_unrest_county ?= { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_rebel_march_modifier years = 8 } }
				increase_wounds_effect = { REASON = fight }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = brave
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = wrathful
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0800.b
		trigger = {
			diplomacy >= 10
		}
		stress_impact = {
			forgiving = minor_stress_impact_loss
			vengeful = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		scope:eir_unrest_county ?= { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_saxon_moot_modifier years = 12 } }
		scope:eir_unrest_county ?= { remove_county_modifier = eir_saxon_uprising_modifier }
		eir_resent_clear_effect = yes
